notes.title: Update record January 31
notes.notes:
1. Fix the problem that the silent water in the rune is invalid

2. The duration of each level of sword spirit field is reduced from 2 seconds to 1 second

3. Fix the problem that 2 sets of random suit are invalid (at present, 4 sets activate 2 sets and 4 sets effect)

4. Repairing the passive skill attribute of ice species is affected by the skill level of ice trace roar

5. Special effect transfer adds some detection sections to avoid that players can operate in the magic box without going to the forging place for special effect transfer

The problem that causes the item to disappear

6. Slightly reduce the damage calculation rule algorithm caused by PVP

7. Join the new season buff event [lucky week]

8. Fixed the problem of client clan and guild icon reverse

9. Repair the problem that Prajna King Kong is still affected by the time increase of this life's magic weapon

10. Fix the problem that the shaper received by VIP can be fixed. (fixed online)

11. Fixed invalid glyph duration after enchantment augmentation paper

12. Fix the problem that the skills of the old Yu Wang used the skills of the old legendary boss Huofeng

13. The upper limit of liquid medicine stack is increased from 200 to 1000 bottles

14. Fix the problem that the secret place does not drop the psychic pieces

15. Fix the problem that the cultivation level of spirit weapons forging book and spirit clothing forging book is 1 after they are thrown to the ground

16. [lockstone] was only valid for PVE, and will also be valid for PVP after update

17. The effect of magic flame sky armor is reduced from 100% to 40%
